message: Build a refined static index.html mini exhibition for a fictional paper-art artist. Include six original CSS artwork tiles, captions and a keyboard-accessible detail dialog with close button and Escape support returning focus to its opener. Add artist biography and fictional contact text. Mobile-friendly inline CSS/vanilla JS, no external assets, forms or build step.

profile.sections: use the sections in the brief
profile.platform: local Windows and Python 3 stdlib for CLI; modern desktop/mobile browser for web
profile.defaults: Smallest solution described; no accounts, network, deployment or paid assets. Ask before scope or budget changes.
